review_scope: One bounded independent post-draft review of four revised figures, 79 plotted values, new N=1 explanations and the affected main/detail scaling tables.
classification: Custom study; descriptive figure revision of frozen scores.
basis: The earlier 55-check report review is retained. This receipt covers only the new figure revision and does not repeat that report review.
logic_checks: Naive N=1 uses saved EA_MI: average eight individual scores within each of 13 documents, then equal document weighting. The 104 individual scores per budget are not claimed as independent experiments.
N>=2 remains EA_MV. The legend, caption and text disclose the different individual-scorer and legacy-voter answer-format acceptance rules; N=1 is not claimed to be a newly evaluated singleton vote.
Cached and PoolAct have no fabricated N=1 values. Their lines start at N=2; the affected report tables state that N=1 was not run.

The independently executed ExpGym Max N=1 references remain unconnected open diamonds: 13 documents with three orders each. Order, context-limit and cache-setting differences are stated; these are not shared strategy anchors.
Per-agent budgets are fixed, total pool budgets increase with N, subsets are dependent, and no confidence intervals or significance claims were added.
All ablation panels retain their own metric units, zero baselines and negative intermediate differences. Peer-to-Graph is described as a package change; Graph retains internal data-structure locks.
Same-version effort comparison remains primary; historical rescoring reference remains secondary with cross-version limitations. Both efforts retain thinking.
The new figures do not change the frozen 210-setting table, 1334 formal jobs, 3146 formal agent trajectories, or the separate 21-job/63-agent technical cohort.

artifact_and_presentation_checks.visual_result: Legible panels, axes and legends; N=1 markers distinguish MI and the independent reference. No visible clipping or overlapping labels that obscure values.

limitations: This is a finite figure/data correspondence review, not a new raw-data, source-runtime, archive-content or full-report audit.
No model calls, scorer calls, raw reads, experiment reruns or scientific-table changes were performed.

The connected naive N=1 MI point and N>=2 MV points use explicitly different aggregation contracts; their connecting segment is descriptive and does not establish a uniform-voter or causal N=1-to-N=2 effect.
Author-side byte replay, font embedding and the full document link check were not independently repeated. Visual review does not certify a specific venue format.
Publication-index updates, credential scanning, commit and push are outside this receipt.
